ownerDiary.title: How to use the diary
ownerDiary.intro: The diary is where you keep your glucose, insulin, carbohydrates, meal, photo, and note records.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: The main diary actions are available directly from this screen.
entries.create: Tap “+” to create a new entry.
entries.edit: Tap an entry card to open it and change its data.
entries.photo: Tap a photo in a card to open it full screen.

search.title: Search and filters
search.description: Use search when you need to quickly find a specific record.
search.field: Choose what to search by in the dropdown above the search field.
search.input: Enter text or a numeric value in the search field.
search.filters: Use the filter button to narrow entries by date, metrics, meal relation, photo, or AI analysis.

organization.title: Organizing the list
organization.day: Tap a day header to collapse or expand that day.
organization.allDays: The header menu can collapse or expand all days on the current page.
organization.pages: Use pagination at the bottom of the list to move between pages.

selection.title: Working with several entries
selection.description: Selection mode is useful when the same action should be applied to several records.
selection.open: Choose “Select entries” in the header menu, then select the records you need.
selection.actions: Selected entries can be synchronized or deleted together.

sync.title: Synchronization
sync.description: New and changed entries are stored on this device first. Synchronization sends pending changes to the cloud when a connection is available.
sync.status: The status on an entry card shows whether it is synchronized, pending, synchronizing, or being deleted.
sync.manual: Choose “Synchronize” in the header menu to start synchronization manually.

photoAi.title: Photos, AI, and timer
photoAi.photo: A photo can be added from the camera or photo library and replaced later.
photoAi.redaction: Before saving a photo, you can hide private areas directly in the photo editor.
photoAi.ai: AI food analysis can estimate food and nutrients from a photo. The estimate is approximate and should not be used to calculate an insulin dose.
photoAi.timer: When creating an entry, you can optionally set the built-in 2-hour glucose check timer.

ownerCloudDiary.title: How to use the cloud
ownerCloudDiary.intro: The cloud shows synchronized copies of your diary entries. You can review cloud entries here and download selected entries back to this device.

about.title: What is stored in the cloud
about.description: The cloud and the local diary serve different purposes.
about.syncedOnly: This screen shows only entries that have already been synchronized with the cloud.
about.editInDiary: Create and edit entries in the Diary section.
about.afterSync: Changes from the local diary appear in the cloud after successful synchronization.

viewing.title: Viewing entries
viewing.photo: Tap a photo in a card to open it full screen.
viewing.pages: Use the navigation buttons at the bottom of the list to move between pages.
viewing.refresh: Choose “Refresh list” in the header menu to load the latest entries from the cloud again.

download.title: Downloading entries
download.description: Cloud entries can be saved to the local diary on this device.
download.select: Choose “Select entries” in the header menu.
download.choose: Select the entries you need. You can select several entries or all entries on the current page.
download.start: Tap “Download” to check and transfer the selected entries to the local diary.

conflicts.title: If an entry already exists on the device
conflicts.description: Before downloading, the app checks the selected entries. If the same entry already exists locally, you can choose how to resolve the conflict.
conflicts.skip: “Skip all conflicts” keeps the existing local entries unchanged.
conflicts.replace: “Replace all conflicts” replaces conflicting local entries with the cloud versions.
conflicts.review: “Review individually” lets you choose an action for each conflicting entry.

result.title: After downloading
result.local: Successfully downloaded entries are stored in the local diary on this device.
result.noAutomaticUpload: Entries downloaded from the cloud are not uploaded back to the cloud automatically.
result.summary: When the operation finishes, the app shows how many entries were added, replaced, skipped, or failed.

followerDiary.title: How to use the followed user's diary
followerDiary.intro: This screen lets you view the diaries of users assigned to your account.

about.title: How this diary works
about.description: The follower diary is intended for viewing data from assigned users.
about.readOnly: This is a read-only view: entries cannot be created, edited, or deleted here.
about.cloudData: The screen shows cloud entries for the currently selected user.
about.syncDelay: A new or changed entry appears here after the user successfully synchronizes their diary.

viewing.title: Viewing entries
viewing.entries: If several users are assigned, choose the one you need from the selector above the diary. Entry cards can show date and time, metrics, meal relation, comment, and AI analysis when available.
viewing.photo: Tap a photo in an entry card to open it full screen.
viewing.pages: Use the navigation buttons at the bottom of the list to move between diary pages.

refresh.title: Refreshing the diary
refresh.description: If the user recently added or changed entries, you can refresh the list manually.
refresh.action: Choose “Refresh list” in the header menu.
refresh.latest: The app checks the current list of assigned users again and refreshes the selected diary.

unassigned.title: If no user is assigned
unassigned.description: At least one user must be assigned to your account before a diary can be viewed.
unassigned.noDiary: No diaries are available until at least one user is assigned.
unassigned.refresh: After assignment, choose “Refresh list” to make the app check access again.

profile.title: How to use your profile
profile.intro: The profile shows your account details and lets you change sign-in settings or sign out.
profile.userIntro: The profile lets you manage your account and also create diary backups or import them back to this device.

account.title: Profile information
account.description: The upper part of the screen shows the main details of your account.
account.email: Email is used to sign in and can be changed with the “Change email” action.
account.role: Your role determines which sections and capabilities are available to your account.

security.title: Account and security
security.changeEmail: “Change email” replaces the email address used by your account.
security.changePassword: “Change password” lets you set a new sign-in password.
security.logout: Sign out ends the current session on this device.

transfer.title: Diary import and export
transfer.description: This section lets you save local diary entries to a file or restore entries from a previously created backup.
transfer.open: Tap “Import and export” in the profile to open the data transfer module.
transfer.localData: The module works with the local diary on this device. Export reads locally available entries and import changes the local diary.

exportFormats.title: Export formats
exportFormats.description: After choosing Export, the app asks which file format to create.
exportFormats.fullBackup: Full backup — a ZIP containing entries and locally stored photos. This file can be imported back into DOne.
exportFormats.lightweightBackup: Lightweight backup — entries without local photo files. Existing cloud photo links are preserved.
exportFormats.csv: CSV — a table file for viewing and working with diary data in spreadsheet apps. CSV cannot be imported back into DOne.

exportScope.title: Which entries to export
exportScope.all: “All entries” exports every locally available diary entry.
exportScope.period: “Period” lets you choose a date range and export only entries within it.
exportScope.selected: “Selected entries” lets you manually choose individual diary entries.

exportResult.title: After an export is created
exportResult.description: When the file is ready, the app shows the export result and basic information about the created file.
exportResult.save: “Save” stores the created file using the device system controls.
exportResult.share: “Send” opens the system share menu so the file can be passed to another app or person.
exportResult.stored: The created export remains in DOne's created exports list until you delete it.

savedExports.title: Created and unfinished exports
savedExports.description: The module keeps a list of created export files and exports that can still be resumed.
savedExports.search: Files can be searched by name.
savedExports.resume: An unfinished export can be resumed from its saved progress or deleted.
savedExports.manage: Finished exports can be opened, saved or sent again, selected in bulk, and deleted.
savedExports.importSource: A finished backup from this list can be selected as an import source without choosing the file from the device again.

import.title: Importing a backup
import.description: Import restores entries from a compatible backup into the local diary.
import.source: You can choose a backup from the device or open one of the backups previously created by DOne.
import.backupOnly: DOne backup files can be imported. CSV files cannot be imported.
import.preview: Before changing the diary, the app validates the file and shows a preview with backup type, entry count, photo count, and detected matches.

importConflicts.title: If the same entries already exist
importConflicts.description: If an entry ID from the backup already exists on the device, the app asks how to resolve the conflict.
importConflicts.skip: “Skip all conflicts” keeps the existing local entries unchanged.
importConflicts.replace: “Replace all conflicts” replaces the local versions with entries from the backup.
importConflicts.review: “Review individually” lets you choose Skip or Replace for each matching entry.
importConflicts.confirm: A final import plan is shown before starting. Once the confirmed import begins, it cannot be cancelled.

importSafety.title: Important during import
importSafety.localOnly: Import changes only the local diary on this device. Import itself does not change cloud data.
importSafety.locked: While import is running, diary changes, synchronization, and signing out are temporarily unavailable.
importSafety.result: When import finishes, the app shows how many entries were added, replaced, and skipped.
